destructiveRestoreRunbook: Take a fresh SQL export before any hosted restore command.
Confirm the target D1 database name, database id, account, and environment are the intended Archestimator target.
Treat `wrangler d1 time-travel restore` as destructive because it overwrites the database with a prior state.
Run destructive restore only in a staging or rehearsal D1 database until owner-approved production cutover.
After restore, run schema drift, row-count, foreign-key, authorization-denial, RPC golden-fixture, and route smoke checks before traffic.
note: Local-only D1 export/import restore rehearsal. It creates temporary SQLite databases from sanitized fixture data, dumps SQL, imports into a fresh database, verifies rows/checksums/foreign keys, and removes temp artifacts. It does not read env files, print secret values, call Cloudflare APIs, create D1 databases, deploy Workers, change DNS, run Time Travel restore, or prove a hosted D1 restore.
